top_findings: https://listosoft.com/robots.txt returns HTTP 404 (robots.root.txt not deployed to domain root) and /sitemap.xml is 404
Domain root https://listosoft.com/ returns HTTP 200 with meta refresh + JS redirect instead of a server-side 301 to /Inicio/
og:image, twitter:image, and Organization.logo JSON-LD all point to a broken 404 URL (assets/IsotipoListosoft.png)
Navbar and footer are injected 100% client-side via fetch() with cache: 'no-store', hiding navigation from non-JS bots and causing CLS
Internal links across HTML pages and components.js use .html extensions, triggering unnecessary 301 redirects on every hop
quick_wins: Deploy robots.root.txt to /var/www/html/robots.txt with Sitemap: https://listosoft.com/Inicio/sitemap.xml
Create/fix OG image (1200x630) and point Organization.logo to an existing 200 OK PNG
Replace root meta refresh with an Apache 301 redirect to https://listosoft.com/Inicio/
Remove .html extensions from all internal hrefs in HTML files and components.js
Enable ErrorDocument 404 /Inicio/404.html, add security headers in .htaccess, and add defer to scripts + lazy/dimensions to images

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: HTTP to HTTPS 301 redirect active on listosoft.com
Clean extensionless URLs return 200 OK across all main pages
Gzip compression and browser caching rules configured in .htaccess
Valid XML sitemap at /Inicio/sitemap.xml excluding noindex pages

findings.title: Root robots.txt returns HTTP 404
findings.description: GET https://listosoft.com/robots.txt returns 404 while only /Inicio/robots.txt returns 200. Crawlers only check the domain root.
findings.recommendation: Deploy robots.root.txt to /var/www/html/robots.txt declaring Sitemap: https://listosoft.com/Inicio/sitemap.xml.

findings.title: Soft meta-refresh redirect on domain root
findings.description: https://listosoft.com/ returns HTTP 200 with <meta http-equiv='refresh' content='0; url=/Inicio/'> and window.location.replace.
findings.recommendation: Configure a server-side HTTP 301 redirect in /var/www/html/.htaccess from / to https://listosoft.com/Inicio/.

findings.title: Internal links trigger 301 redirects (.html suffix)
findings.description: HTML files and components.js link to *.html URLs even though .htaccess 301-redirects them to extensionless URLs.
findings.recommendation: Update all internal links in HTML and components.js to clean extensionless paths.

findings.title: Client-side only navbar and footer injection
findings.description: components.js fetches navbar.html and footer.html with cache: 'no-store' after DOMContentLoaded, leaving raw HTML without navigation links.
findings.recommendation: Pre-render navbar and footer directly into the static HTML pages.

findings.title: Missing HTTP security headers and disabled custom 404
findings.description: No HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, or Referrer-Policy headers; ErrorDocument 404 is commented out in .htaccess.
findings.recommendation: Add standard security headers and uncomment ErrorDocument 404 /Inicio/404.html in .htaccess.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Clear Ecuador-focused value proposition (SRI, IESS, IVA, 25 years since 2001)
Strong brand story in fsoft.html (1,074 words) and complete privacy policy (1,515 words)

findings.title: Thin content on core commercial and support pages
findings.description: soporte.html (233 words), recursos.html (338 words), Sobre-nosotros.html (371 words), and index.html (389 words) lack depth for competitive ERP queries.
findings.recommendation: Uncomment/refine the implementation process section, add FAQs, and expand product/compliance explanations.

findings.title: Missing customer testimonials and local trust details
findings.description: Client logos are shown without quotes/case studies, and Sobre-nosotros.html lacks street address, RUC, and leadership profiles.
findings.recommendation: Add 2-3 verified client testimonials and complete Guayaquil office/company trust details.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Homepage title (54 chars) and meta description (143 chars) are well-sized
Self-referencing canonical tags present on all main pages
Single H1 per content page and lang='es' set consistently

findings.title: Broken og:image and twitter:image (404)
findings.description: https://listosoft.com/Inicio/assets/IsotipoListosoft.png returns HTTP 404 across all pages using OG/Twitter tags.
findings.recommendation: Create a 1200x630 OG image in assets/ and update og:image and twitter:image across all pages.

findings.title: Short titles, over-long description, and missing OG on Sobre-nosotros
findings.description: Titles on fsoft (14), modulos (19), recursos (20), Sobre-nosotros (26), soporte (29) are too short; modulos description is 203 chars; Sobre-nosotros lacks OG/Twitter tags.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite titles to 50-60 chars with target keywords, trim modulos description to <=155 chars, and add OG/Twitter tags to Sobre-nosotros.html.

findings.title: Heading level skips (h1 -> h3) and missing H1 on 404
findings.description: recursos.html, soporte.html, and versiones/*.html jump from h1 directly to h3; 404.html has no h1 or noindex tag.
findings.recommendation: Restore sequential h1 -> h2 -> h3 hierarchy and add h1 + noindex to 404.html.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid SoftwareApplication and Organization JSON-LD on index.html
Valid BreadcrumbList JSON-LD on inner pages

findings.title: Organization.logo points to 404 image
findings.recommendation: Point Organization.logo to an existing 200 OK logo PNG and add trailing slash to Organization.url.

findings.title: Incomplete Organization/SoftwareApplication properties and missing page schemas
findings.description: Missing sameAs social links, foundingDate, email, featureList, softwareVersion, WebSite, AboutPage, ContactPage, and Article schemas.
findings.recommendation: Enrich index.html JSON-LD and add page-specific schemas across inner pages.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Total local asset footprint is compact (0.55 MB)
Preconnect hints present for Google Fonts

findings.title: Render-blocking synchronous scripts and duplicate icon libraries
findings.description: index.html loads Font Awesome CSS + Lucide JS + tsParticles + EmailJS + 3 local scripts without defer/async.
findings.recommendation: Add defer to scripts, remove duplicate icon library, and defer or lazy-init tsParticles.

findings.title: Layout shift (CLS) from dynamic navbar and unsized images
findings.description: Navbar loads asynchronously with cache: 'no-store' and 16-18 images lack width/height attributes.
findings.recommendation: Inline/pre-render navbar and add explicit width and height attributes to all images.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Clear factual claims (25 years, Ecuador, SRI, Guayaquil) in body copy

findings.title: Missing llms.txt and root robots.txt AI crawler policy
findings.recommendation: Publish https://listosoft.com/llms.txt and explicit Allow rules for search/AI crawlers in root robots.txt.

findings.title: JS-injected navigation and lack of structured Q&A passages
findings.description: Non-JS AI crawlers cannot see site navigation from raw HTML, and pages lack direct Q&A blocks for answer-engine citation.
findings.recommendation: Pre-render navigation links in HTML and add concise Q&A sections covering ERP features, SRI compliance, and implementation.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All tags on index.html and Sobre-nosotros.html include descriptive alt text

findings.title: Oversized white logo PNG and missing WebP/lazy loading
findings.description: assets/Logo-ListosoftBlanco.png is 171.4 KB (10.6x larger than Logo-Listosoft.png); below-the-fold client logos lack loading='lazy' and WebP.
findings.recommendation: Optimize Logo-ListosoftBlanco.png (or convert to SVG/WebP) and convert client logos to WebP with loading='lazy' and explicit dimensions.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Replace root meta-refresh with Apache 301 redirect to /Inicio/
Enable ErrorDocument 404 /Inicio/404.html and add H1 + noindex to 404.html

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Remove .html extensions from all internal links and components.js
Pre-render navbar and footer in static HTML and drop cache: 'no-store'
Add HTTP security headers in .htaccess and remove wildcard HTML CORS
Add defer to scripts, remove duplicate icon library, optimize Logo-ListosoftBlanco.png, add lazy loading & image dimensions
Optimize titles, meta descriptions, OG tags on Sobre-nosotros, and heading hierarchy

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Enrich JSON-LD (Organization sameAs/foundingDate, SoftwareApplication featureList, WebSite, AboutPage, ContactPage, Article)
Expand thin pages, reactivate #proceso section, add FAQ section with FAQPage schema, add client testimonials
Publish https://listosoft.com/llms.txt for AI search readiness

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Verify domain property in Google Search Console and submit /Inicio/sitemap.xml
Keep sitemap lastmod dates synced on deploy and monitor CrUX Core Web Vitals monthly
